name: comp-69
title: Textarea Right Button
blurb: Textarea with a Send button aligned to the right.
description: A textarea with an outline Button component aligned right using flex justify-end. For form submission after message entry.
use_when: Forms where the action button should be right-aligned for visual hierarchy.
avoid_when: The button needs to be full-width or centered.
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Button is separate and clearly labeled.
